name: Ningbo PIA Automation Holding Corp.
summary: Ningbo PIA Automation Holding Corp. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of assembly and testing, intelligent manufacturing equipment, industrial robots, and industrial digital intelligent software in China and internationally. The company offers advanced driver assistance system, components, electric drive, powertrain, and car safety products; and various services, including cell/module pack assembly, fuel cell assembly, component assembly, component handling, and battery recycling services.
